Khamoshi ko agyaanta aur shaanti ko swikaar mat samjho.
Grit effort ko destiny banata hai.
Grit sirf talent nahi hota.
Jo karna chahiye, woh karo.
Brave shayad long live na karein, cautious waise bhi survive nahi karte.
Chup rehna sabse bada hathiyaar hai.
Kabhi rukna nahi; kabhi settle nahi.
Himmat na chillana—bas khade rehna.
Sabse strong jawab kabhi kabhi khamoshi.
Khamoshi doosre tareeqon se ki gayi behas hai.
Aur silence nahi chahiye—zyada courage chahiye.
Quiet mind strong hote.
Himmat rakh aur meherbaan reh.
Inaction doubt aur fear paida karta.
Khamoshi bhaag hai.
Kabhi kabhi khamoshi sabse loud hoti hai.
Abhi bahadur bano.
Hamesha bahadur raho.
Khamoshi aatma ka pavitra sthan hai.
Kabhi kabhi humein chup rehna chahiye.
Asli taqat shant dil mein basti hai.
